0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>A rather skittish Mord is at his wit's end and might be glad of a helping hand.

24.original: Defeat the wild beasts at Samiel's Backbone.

48.original: You there! Kind traveler, strong traveler! The younglings are in danger!

49.original: Big, scary creatures! They looked hungry, too!

50.original: Please, you must hurry to Samiel's Backbone, east from here! Quickly, there is no time!

51.original: You do not know Samiel's Backbone!? Just go east, then!

52.original: Do not eat me! Mord fur very hard to swallow, I hear! Tickle your belly, it will!

53.original: Great samiel, we are truly sorry!

54.original: We are...not dead? Oh, you saved us, that is why! A thousand thousand thank-yous!

55.original: I never thought I would be so happy to not be dead! Many thanks, stranger!

56.original: I have never been eaten alive before, but I do not imagine it is very pleasant.

57.original: If you had not rescued us, we would be in the belly of a beast, and probably not in one piece, either.

58.original: You did it! These two have a lot to answer for, though.

59.original: You see, those bones once belonged to a mighty samiel, whose ghost still roams the plains! A lot of silly younglings go there to prove their bravery. But there are things much more dangerous than wandering spirits, oh yes!

60.original: I <hex:021A020203>wish<hex:021A020103> it was a ghost we had met instead of those horrible brutes! We will not be going back there any time soon!

61.original: Speak for yourself! I was hoping to meet the great samiel, so I want to try it again. And I will not have the others calling me a coward for running away!

62.original: To tell the truth, I did exactly the same thing when I was their age. It is something of a tradition!

63.original: This is one of the ways we learn to fear and respect the desert, but also how we find the courage to face its many dangers. Though on this occasion, I think we would be two younglings short of a village were it not for you! Mord Souq thanks you, traveler!
